---
title: "Selectors and roles"
---

* Recipe steps operate on columns of data, which are specified using Polars selectors.
* Roles add a new dimension for selection.
  - "feature"
  - "target"
  - "case_weights" (doesn't matter yet)
  - Common
    - excluding targets (all numeric features)
* Custom roles
  - https://recipes.tidymodels.org/articles/Roles.html?q=role#role-inheritance
* Print equiv of recipe summary table
